book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: O baala oka Yeso ka ezeaza o beya angmǝ ka Ashili

Ngmende Yeso ka ya beya angmǝ ka Ashili a ara. Malo oka ka mare, na ondo a nyimi atoma a kai wa bekaa kai na, “Ateokora, baala ro nangka teyo beya angmǝ ka Ashili, nangka Yohana ka o batisma ka baale ana o tare wai.”
Naka bekaa ne na, “Eeya beya angmǝ ka Ashili, e bekaana:

content.text: a monte leze lo a sangsang,
a togomo to de a komana ka kuruwǝ.
o baale ro nangka teyo pisǝ
andaaka ne eze ro epa e buru,
Tana o baya a te lyǝ a nyimi o kedeya ne.’ ”

content: Naka bekaa ne na, “A mana ondo ying waye ka oja, na wa ale a wai a tera lelyaare. A wa bekaana, ‘Bejaa, kopeng agwataka taaro a lya.
Oja ong yende wa surǝ a begere na wa japi a me, a mi naana anta ka epa o nya wai ne.’
“A wiinea oja wai oka wa ya nyimi wata kabare na, ‘Tana o gareng ne. Ma samba o pate abuudu a ma tete ka yana ang, ma era anta ama o era kang nyau eyapa ne?’
Nyimia, eyang baalo ying, waata era ka wa nya oja o wai epaolya aza obena beja be wai ne, wayo nya wai pate epa eka waya gera me o bena wata wa kona ezǝng o gara wai ne.
“Azaa nyimi eyang beya aying, bosaza na Ashili a yo nya ying, gerza na ara ai eyo cǝ, gwarazana buudu a ai a yo pari ying.
Pate ondooka wa bosa, a yo nya wai, pate ondooka wa gera wayo cǝ, kanza pate ondooka wa gwara abuudu a yo pari wai.
“Mana a nyimi o ying anate, ka o yana wai wa bosa bekwala, a wa nya wai owa?
Na o yana wai wa bose lengma, a wa nya wai onyakara?
Ying ana epa e buru, e rose nangka e nyaza ayana ying epa e rere, shebari Ate ying o zaa shili wayo nya obere wai andaaka ne boseze wai.”
Legoone le Yeso le kala le Baazabul
Yeso kaya za o sǝǝrǝ o bere o buru o nara ngmǝ oromo yende. Malo surǝ o bere o buru me, na oromo me bora o beya ngmǝ, na epame tere aromo me okpwe.
Na ana ondo one bekaana, “Kakama. Baazabul
, ogomo mabere ma buru, wa ya wa nya kai legoone lo sǝǝrǝ o bere o buru.”
Ana ondo kadeya Yeso, nane bekaa kai na, kaye epa e mole ka rose bena Ashili ya malo ogole o kai.
Yeso ka ka rose madoola mane naka bekaa ne na: “Pate togomo teeka te arnang, teyo caro, aromo akwilǝ ne arnang akwilǝ me a yo rizi.
Ogomo o bere o buru wa arnang okpwe wai, togomo te wai yo ya legoone nannia? Ma beka nyimi ko bena e bekaana ka legoone le Baazabul waya ang sǝrsǝzǝ o bere o buru.
Ma sǝrsǝzǝ o bere o buru ka legoone le Baazabul, ana o tare o ying sǝrsǝzǝ ka le mana? Nyimia waaza, ana o tare o ying neya yo core ying angmǝ me.
A ma sǝrsǝsǝ o bere o buru ka o ara Ashili, na togomo te Ashili te deya ying naname.
“A were aka ondo legoone, wa babare okpwe wai ka magogoro ma o kara, a wa ende akwilǝ a wai, okǝri wa era awata kwǝ magogoro ma akwilǝ wai ne.
A ondo kala wai a legoone wa deya a wa zala wai ko kara wayo kala wai, a wa jeka magogoro mo kara maaka wa eke lenyong ne a wa beshe magogoro ma oromo me.
O kurǝ obere oburu
“Ondooka wata ya lendo ka mi ne ondo nyana onnga wai, nyimia ondooka wata kurǝ ka mi ne, waya bacakara.
“Obere o buru wa suraa nyimi oromo, a wa ale a nyimi o wake a gera ara o teseke. Waata cǝ ne, a wa bekaana, ‘Eyang kurǝ ara oromo amea ma surǝ ne.’
Wa kurǝ, wayo mana oromo omea na akwilǝ ka aya sangsang a eyapa ta rene ne.
A wa yo kurǝ kawa jeke mabere ma buru o sondaare maaka ma kala o bora me ba ara a buru, kane lyǝ ba oromo me aa ne cikǝ a nyimi o wai. Nyimia o maare oromo me wayo kala o bora wai o burǝ.”
O kona o leba edang
Nangka Yeso kaya beya angmǝ name, na ondaye yende a nyimi aromo a cak bekaana, “Ondo kona o leba ondaye omea wa ngmengoo aa ba ase a wai.”
Na Yeso kabare na, “Wa kala a kona o leba andaaka ne kona angmǝ Ashili ane ezeze ogole ka ai.”
Ana o nyana Ashiline bosa o laka ogole Ashili
Nangka aromo me ne wale o gongnga ne, na Yeso bekaana, “Lenna lepeza le burua le. Ne ya yeme a wore ne ogole o Ashili, a era ta wore ne ne sekona Yonana ondo o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili.
Nangka Yonana ogole Ashili waze aromo apeng a Neneba, nyimia mi Kena ka Ashili kaze a wereena.

Aya ogong o makeke ma o Sheba wayo era a lengme lo maare kawa beke epa eka wa rose. Ka wa bekaa aromo me na neta neeya epa e woma ne. Aza o bena wa deya awa suri a macangcang ka wa kone o rosa ogomo Suleimanu. A nannamena, ondooka wa kala Suleimanu ya arakaana pate ka nyimi eta e kona kai ne.

Aromo apeng Neneba neyo itǝ a lengme lo maare kale peza le wereena kane nyane o rizi one. Ka ne kuri ara Ashili a were e ka Yonana ka baale ne ngmǝ Ashili, a nannamena ondooka wa kala Yonana ya arakana na eta e kurǝ Ashili ne.
O baala Yeso wa nyaza masanto
“Ondo wa era wata diki biru be masanto a wa eke ara aka wayo baasa beene, koona wa pate be ka oso ne. Wayo eke ara a zaati, adorana andaaka neya lyǝzǝ akwilǝ me ane laka masanto.
Liizi le oromo leya na masanto ma lepung le wai. A yizi au aya ka edang, lepung lo a pate yo ya ka masanto. A yizi me a ta rera ne, lepung lo a pate yo ya ka maring
Soleke na, kana masanto maaka maya ying maringnga mai ne ma lenyong.
Azaa nyimi, nyimi lenyong lo leya ka masanto, lepung lo a pate masantoa yoza, a ara maring tozene ne, pate le leyo ya masanto, nangka masanto ma beru ezeze masanto a bo.”
Yeso ka zurki ana o baala angmǝaka Ashili a nya Mosa
Nangka Yeso ka mare o beya ngmǝ ka aromo, na oParisa yende bose kai kane ale a lya epaolya ba akwilǝ wai. Na Yeso kabare o ale naka cikǝ ara o lyeeze epaolya me.
Na oParisa me, nangka wa laka Yeso aka ta ka kwizǝ taara zongka ka bore o lya epaolya ne,
na epame itǝ a wai ba lenyong.
Na Ateokora bekaa wai na, “Lakai, ying maParisa e kpwizizi malo o poto a ka oso, a nyimi me ka madinǝ, e pena ka o nyalang ka epa e buru.
Ying a rara. Ondo oka wa eze malo wa ya wa eze nyimi lenyong kanza sang?
Nyana andaaka ne dere epa eka eya nyimi oso me, e keeya yo ya ying ba sangsang.

“E lyǝ udi ying maParisa, e nyaza Ashili oyende ba nyimi be tuuru e leto, egweng kaa kombela mananggo, a e nyana o eza e epa eka eya kapo kanza ko yeme Ashili. Eeyo eza o maare ka waya o yeme Ashili zora o baya o bora ka waye ka edang.
“E lyǝ udi ying maParisa ana okpwe o gong, ying naana e yeme tora to ciisǝ te moole a nyimi o dandaro gwarzanang maYahuda e kang yeme makoo ara ejamane.
“E lyǝ udi, e rere o yangga na macau maaka ma wilǝ e kang burǝ na a nyimi macau mame, ka aromo itǝzǝ ne ane ta rosa ne.”
Na ondo a nyimi ana o rosa ngmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa wa kabare na, “Ondo o baala, ba beka nyimi, a ba lya mainu maro kanza.”

Na Yeso kabare na, “Ying ma kanza e lyǝ udi ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa. E anza aromo magogoro ma dengdeng ka deketea ne anza aza angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa o poba oya. Aying ka topkwe to ying e era eta kangkama ne ko ka lebo le yende ne.
“E lyǝ udi, ka e ezeze nangka magonggong ma ying eze, o sooza macau ma ana o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili, kanza magonggong ma ying neya ne wonze ne.
Ying a tokpwe to ying e wore o bena e kabare ka epa eka magonggong ma ying ne eze. Ne wonze ana o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili aying e sooze ne macau
Azaa nyimi, Ashili ba nyimi o rosa ai a bekaana, ‘Eyang tonga ne ana o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili ka atoma Yeso, neyo wonga na ondo one, ane gǝǝzǝ na ondo.’
Aza nyimi, aromo tomore toona neyo ana manyau ma ra aburu a pate ana o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili ka a wongze o era o bora lerambo le Ashili.
O era bora ka ma nyau ma Habila a deya a ma nyau ma Zakariya,
oka a wong a tera ara a sangsang Ashili ka ara o kala be sangsang a Ashili. Eeye, eyang baalo ying, aromo tomore toona neyo ana madinǝ mame ba pat.

“E lyǝ udi ying ana o rosa angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa, eta rosa Ashili ne a ekang dame ana o yeme o rosa me orona, e samba o jeka epa mo pari abuudu o rosa. Ying a topkwe to ying eta e lyǝ ne, aying e kang nara andaaka neya lyǝzǝ.”
Nangka Yeso ka baya arakaname, na maParisa ka ana baala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa ne bore o nyana kai ba jǝng ane gare kai ka bepirǝ,
adorana ne laka o rizi o kai aza e epa eka ka yo beka.
